title: Code Comprehensor: Hierarchical Documentation and Cross-Modal Retrieval for Large Repositories
abstract: arXiv:2610.30016v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Understanding large, complex, and rapidly evolving code bases remains a core challenge for software engineering at scale, hindering onboarding, maintenance, refactoring, and impact analysis. Providing this information to a Large-Language Model (LLM) is another hurdle, as the LLM must understand not only the required code method but also its associated methods in the grand scheme of the repository. We propose Code Comprehensor, a hybrid retrieval-reasoning framework combining (i) a code dependency callgraph, (ii) CodeScribe, which uses code-aware LLMs to generate hierarchical documentation across repository call graphs, and (iii) CodeContrast, a CLIP-style dual-encoder model trained on CodeScribe output to learn aligned text-code embeddings. CodeContrast enables fast, semantically precise retrieval of relevant code-context neighborhoods, which serve as grounded evidence for an MCP-based LLM orchestrator answering domain-specific queries

translated_title: Code Comprehensor：面向大型代码仓库的层次化文档与跨模态检索
translated_abstract: 理解大型、复杂且快速演进的代码库仍然是规模化软件工程的核心挑战，它阻碍了新人上手、代码维护、重构和影响分析。将这些信息提供给大语言模型（LLM）是另一个障碍，因为LLM不仅需要理解所需的代码方法，还需要理解其在整个仓库全局结构中相关联的方法。我们提出了Code Comprehensor，这是一个混合检索-推理框架，结合了：（i）代码依赖调用图，（ii）CodeScribe——利用代码感知的LLM在仓库调用图上生成层次化文档，（iii）CodeContrast——一个CLIP风格的双编码器模型，基于CodeScribe的输出进行训练以学习对齐的文本-代码嵌入。CodeContrast能够实现快速、语义精准的相关代码上下文邻域检索，这些邻域作为基于MCP的LLM编排器回答领域特定查询时的可靠依据。
tldr: 该论文提出Code Comprehensor混合检索-推理框架，通过代码依赖调用图、层次化文档生成（CodeScribe）和CLIP式跨模态检索模型（CodeContrast），实现对大型代码库相关代码上下文的快速语义精准检索，并为基于MCP的LLM问答提供可靠依据。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Code Comprehensor, a hybrid retrieval-reasoning framework combining code dependency callgraphs, hierarchical documentation generation via CodeScribe, and a CLIP-style cross-modal dual-encoder CodeContrast, enabling fast and semantically precise retrieval of relevant code context to ground MCP-based LLM question answering over large repositories.
